sections.expectedOutput: Kubernetes v1.31.14, three Ready nodes, and ui4a-system with istio-injection=enabled when already installed.
sections.failureCriterion: kubectl cannot reach the cluster, any node is NotReady, or surveyed versions/node names differ.
sections.recoveryAction: Stop before rendering; follow ../mothership-setup/K8S-ISTIO-DEPLOY.md to restore the existing cluster.

sections.expectedOutput: Exactly postgres/runtime/backup/pki claims are Bound to reviewed Retain volumes or a reviewed replaceable StorageClass.
sections.failureCriterion: A claim is Pending, a local path/node differs from the overlay, or reclaimPolicy is not Retain.
sections.recoveryAction: Do not delete claims; correct the overlay or provisioner decision and repeat the read-only inventory.

sections.expectedOutput: Overlay PASS and every release image available by immutable @sha256 reference with the release OCI revision.
sections.failureCriterion: Any placeholder, mutable tag, digest mismatch, missing layer, or OCI revision mismatch.
sections.recoveryAction: Stop; repeat the exact export/checksum/import procedure in the mothership overlay runbook without pruning containerd content.

sections.expectedOutput: The namespace is injected and the UI4A Gateway, two host routes, JWT rule and authorization policies exist.
sections.failureCriterion: Injection is absent, hosts/issuer/audience drift, or an internal callback route is exposed externally.
sections.recoveryAction: Do not bypass Istio; fix values and rerender deploy/helm/ui4a before apply.

sections.expectedOutput: Ingress TLS Secret metadata exists and retained pki-data is Bound; both internal DNS SANs are verified by the mothership runbook.
sections.failureCriterion: TLS metadata is missing, SAN/issuer is wrong, or pki-data is not retained.
sections.recoveryAction: Stop; restore certificate/PKI artifacts from the verified backup. Never regenerate over an existing root CA or private key.

sections.expectedOutput: PostgreSQL 1/1 Ready and postgres-bootstrap Complete with TLS verify-full configuration.
sections.failureCriterion: StatefulSet is not Ready, bootstrap is not Complete, or postgres-data UID/path changes.
sections.recoveryAction: Inspect postgres and bootstrap logs; do not recreate postgres-data or reset roles.

sections.expectedOutput: Temporal and UI are Ready, schema and namespace Jobs have Complete conditions, and namespace ui4a exists.
sections.failureCriterion: Schema/namespace Job is active or terminal-failed, gRPC probe fails, or persistence authentication fails.
sections.recoveryAction: Keep PostgreSQL intact; inspect Job/server previous logs and rerun only an explicitly reviewed idempotent Job.

sections.expectedOutput: A missing realm reports absent; an existing compatible realm reports skip without mutation.
sections.failureCriterion: KEYCLOAK_REALM_INCOMPATIBLE, an unexpected client set, or any request for drift repair.
sections.recoveryAction: Back up identity state and stop. Replace/rebuild explicitly; never reconcile an existing realm online.

sections.expectedOutput: Migration Job is Complete and reports the expected compatible schema revision.
sections.failureCriterion: Job is active/failed, schema revision is unexpected, or a destructive migration is proposed.
sections.recoveryAction: Stop application rollout; preserve the named backup and use the reviewed compatibility window.

sections.expectedOutput: Single Web and Worker replicas are Ready with immutable release digests.
sections.failureCriterion: Either workload is degraded/not Ready or image/source revision differs from the release.
sections.recoveryAction: Inspect dependency readiness and rollback images; do not scale beyond the supported single replica.

sections.expectedOutput: Worker RBAC permits bounded one-shot Jobs; idle state has no static Runner daemon and each Run has one immutable Job.
sections.failureCriterion: RBAC is broader/missing, an idle daemon exists, or a Run can override image/profile/workspace.
sections.recoveryAction: Disable K8s dispatch and correct server-owned settings/RBAC; never fall back to a wider backend.

sections.expectedOutput: The configured Runner becomes ready and accepts only its exact profile, workspace, image and credential refs.
sections.failureCriterion: runner_delivery_not_configured, token/profile mismatch, path escape, or readiness without an authorized processor.
sections.recoveryAction: Stop the daemon, preserve workspace evidence, fix canonical settings/private token file, and restart without widening permissions.

sections.expectedOutput: Both names resolve to the reviewed ingress address and TLS validation succeeds without -k.
sections.failureCriterion: Resolution differs, curl needs -k, or certificate SAN/chain validation fails.
sections.recoveryAction: Correct DNS/hosts or install the reviewed public CA certificate; never distribute a private key.

sections.expectedOutput: PKCE human login, CLI token reads and bounded sub+azp delegation pass; malformed/expired/forged credentials fail closed.
sections.failureCriterion: Any Agent approval succeeds, scope expands, identity comes from request fields, or credential material appears in output.
sections.recoveryAction: Revoke the test credential, stop acceptance, inspect issuer/audience/JWKS/application identity checks, and do not weaken policy.

sections.expectedOutput: Business flow, delegated proposal, human-only approval, both Runtime backends, restart and audit evidence pass.
sections.failureCriterion: A Pod Running/HTTP 200 substitutes for the story, an Agent approves, or replay/audit evidence differs.
sections.recoveryAction: Keep the experimental release unaccepted; diagnose the first failed user-story boundary and rerun from a clean fixture.

sections.expectedOutput: A named completed manifest covers four databases, runtime, realm/config, PKI/private artifacts; isolated restore reports RPO/RTO and matching authority/identity/Run evidence.
sections.failureCriterion: Checksums/inventory/quiescence are incomplete, target aliases current state, or restored fingerprints differ.
sections.recoveryAction: Resume current writers, retain the incomplete archive for diagnosis, and never restore into the current PVC/database.

sections.expectedOutput: New revision passes smoke, rollback restores old image refs, roll-forward restores the new revision, and HWM/authority hash remain equal.
sections.failureCriterion: Rendered retained Jobs differ, migration is incompatible, smoke fails, or HWM/hash changes unexpectedly.
sections.recoveryAction: Rollback to revision 19 without --force; if data recovery is required, use the verified backup only in an isolated target first.

sections.expectedOutput: Liveness, readiness and dependency failures are distinguishable and logs contain correlation IDs without credentials.
sections.failureCriterion: degraded is reported Ready, previous container errors are hidden, or logs expose Token/API key/password/prompt material.
sections.recoveryAction: Capture only redacted metadata and previous logs, repair the named dependency, then rerun readiness and the bounded smoke.

sections.expectedOutput: Ordinary Compose stop retains volumes; destructive Compose clean requires the exact project confirmation; Helm uninstall leaves Retain PV data for explicit disposition.
sections.failureCriterion: Ordinary stop contains --volumes, any prune/force command appears, or uninstall implicitly deletes retained data.
sections.recoveryAction: Cancel before confirmation. Inventory named volumes/PVC/PV and backup checksums; data deletion is a separate reviewed operation outside this runbook.
